evidence: production-parameters-strict-keep-and-boot-run: node_base.pp:162-165 includes puppet_boot_run when run_puppet_on_boot is true (the prod params fixture sets it); puppet_boot_run's baseline (manifests/puppet_boot_run.pp:11-17, 32-40) installs ${bindir}/puppet_boot_run.sh owner root group root mode 0750 and declares service puppet_boot_run enable true, so 'enabled' and 'root:root 750' are what the code produces; the '-P INPUT DROP' and 0 '110 SSH' rules follow line 101 forwarding ssh_strict true to firewall_secure

dns-is-left-alone: node_base.pp:167-169 passes $nameservers (default [] in the fixture) to dns_client, whose baseline (dns_client.pp:8-12) declares resolv_conf only when nameservers != []; so resolv.conf keeps the node's own nameservers (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8), unchanged before and after the apply, which justifies the invariant

on-redhat-firewalld-masked-chrony-and-the-yum-scripts: node_base.pp:63-76 (RedHat branch) declares service firewalld ensure stopped enable false and exec 'systemctl mask firewalld' unless is-enabled shows masked, matching 'masked' and 'inactive'; with 140-147 (include ::chrony, custom_ntp false) giving chronyd active and 110-111 (filesystem_yum, which installs yum-update-surface.sh and yum-update-dist.sh in place of filesystem_apt's apt-update scripts) giving 'yum scripts present' and 0 apt-update files, on the rhel9 node

purpose covered: The purpose (hardened SSH, default-drop firewall admitting SSH from the ACL, IPv6 drop, base packages without unattended upgrades, server-mode apt scripts, restricted network tools, NTP) matches the header ('basic desirable properties of a generic Ubuntu node') and baseline node_base.pp. Base run: SSH behaviour over loopback (publickey only, kex refusal, a real cipher mismatch control, root login no), firewall policy/ACL whitelist/limit chain and no extra side chain, NTP selecting a source and the clock synchronised, tool group/mode from Hiera, server-mode surface list, component sentinels, DNS left alone, no boot run. rhel variant: the RedHat branch on rhel9 (firewalld masked, chrony, filesystem_yum). prod variant: ssh_strict, run_puppet_on_boot and firewall_strict_purge false with ignore pattern, the last shown behaviourally (the next agent run keeps the planted p8test-keep-me rule and purges p8test-other).
